Create a folder in `src/content/posts/`, add an `index.mdx` and fill in the frontmatter.

## Frontmatter

| Field         | Required | Notes                                      |
| ------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `title`       | yes      |                                            |
| `description` | yes      | Used for the feed and the page metadata    |
| `date`        | yes      | `YYYY-MM-DD`                               |
| `draft`       | no       | `true` keeps the post out of the build     |
| `image`       | no       | Small header image, relative to the folder |
| `imageAlt`    | with `image` | Use `""` only for decorative images    |

## Images

Put images next to `index.mdx` and reference them with a description:

```md
![Terminal showing the build output](./build.png)
```

> Every image needs alt text so that it is accessible.
